name: PSH Request Router API
description: Professional Payment Services Hub (PSH) Request Router API Documentation. This enterprise-grade microservice handles payment initiation requests, action events, and comprehensive payment processing workflows. It provides secure, scalable endpoints for payment transaction routing, queue management, and workflow automation in the Intellect Design Arena platform.
